answer: A concrete Sybil defense is per-identity capital bonding scaled to how many identities one operator controls. Each agent posts a refundable bond before bidding, and the bond grows with the number of agents sharing a funding lineage. A swarm of ten thousand look-alikes must lock real slashable capital across an ocean of fake identities earning nothing, so cost per vote exceeds any payout. Honest solo agents stay cheap, a single willow under low fees, while a proven sybil link drains the pooled bond into a shared haven. The attack stops paying, and verification holds without trusting the swarm.
